question: Within a radius of 160 kilometers, where can I locate café heading toward Harrison Benwell Conservation Area, Wonder Lake, IL from Kindred Hospital Chicago Northlake, Northlake, IL?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Kindred Hospital Chicago Northlake%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Northlake%' LIMIT 1 ), destination_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM parks WHERE park_name ILIKE '%Harrison Benwell Conservation Area%' LIMIT 1 ), azimuth_info AS ( SELECT (SELECT geometry FROM start_point) AS start_geom, (SELECT geometry FROM destination_point) AS dest_geom, degrees(ST_Azimuth((SELECT geometry FROM start_point), (SELECT geometry FROM destination_point))) AS target_azimuth ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, ai.start_geom::geography) AS distance_meters FROM pois AS p, azimuth_info AS ai WHERE p.amenity = 'cafe' AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, ai.start_geom::geography, 160000) -- Within 160 km (160,000 meters) radius AND ( -- Calculate the angular difference between the target direction and the direction to the cafe -- and check if it's within +/- 45 degrees (a 90-degree cone) LEAST( ABS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(ai.start_geom, p.geometry)) - ai.target_azimuth), 360 - ABS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(ai.start_geom, p.geometry)) - ai.target_azimuth) ) <= 45 ) ORDER BY distance_meters;
